name: cta-strip
description: Bold one-line conversion strip — accent-colored band with a headline and 1–2 buttons. Designed as the final pre-footer call-to-action.

ai.whenToUse: Use as the closing call-to-action above the footer. Bold, single-message, one clear next step. Reads site.config.ctaPrimary by default; overridable per-page via content slots.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't stack multiple CTAs above the footer — pick one. Don't use mid-page; mid-page CTAs belong inside other blocks (hero, pricing).

headline.description: Bold headline. Short — one line on desktop.
headline.example: Ready to ship your next side project?

subheadline.description: Optional supporting line under the headline.
subheadline.example: 14-day trial. No credit card. Cancel from your dashboard in two clicks.

primaryCtaText.description: Primary CTA label. Falls back to site.ctaPrimary.

variant.description: Surface treatment: `accent` (primary-color band, default) or `subtle` (alt surface).
